Market today: The AI hype train is still chugging, but there are whispers of caution. Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia was a big deal, but it didn't magically fix everything, and some are seeing this as a chance to buy. Your tech and chip focus means you're right in the thick of it, and margin amplifies every move.

Your holdings: Most of your positions are in the red and flagged for attention (SELL/TRIM). SMCI (-46.17%), SOXL (-84.06%), and MUU (-71.11%) are particularly deep in the hole. Remember, leveraged ETFs like these decay over time and amplify your losses on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market sentiment. While AI is hot, the "warnings behind this week's stock-market rally" suggest we could see some choppiness.

Bottom line: Your leveraged tech bets are taking a beating; focus on managing risk and protecting your capital.
plays: No new buys today - hold and watch.
Consider trimming any positions that are still bleeding cash, especially the leveraged ETFs, to preserve capital.
Respect your stops on all positions, particularly the deeply underwater ones like SMCI and SOXL.
